title: Like a Dragon: Pirate Yakuza in Hawaii — Full Editor Showcase
subtitle: A swashbuckling spin-off tested across every GameQuill block, widget, and formatting tool.

pros: Fast, expressive dual-style combat (Mad Dog & Sea Dog)
Hilarious side stories and naval ship-to-ship battles
Vibrant Hawaiian setting packed with mini-games
cons: Early-game pacing takes a couple of chapters to open up
Some recycled substructures from previous RGG titles
